keyFindings: Improved posterolateral heel bevel creates a much nicer heel transition compared to its predecessor
Dual-layer midsole (stable Cloudtec base + Helion HF top) maintains a firmer platform overall despite maximum stack height, with noticeable bounce after a brief break-in period
Foam provides adequate snap for uptempo efforts and progression runs, but performs best at easier paces where rhythm flows naturally
Wide base and encasing sidewalls resist lateral motion, functioning as a stable neutral option suitable for runners needing guidance
Designed for daily training, long runs, and modest speedwork — more versatile for recreational runners than racing-focused efforts
Dual-density Helion HF foam (springy upper layer over firmer base) creates 'dynamic deep cushion' described as bottomless yet never mushy; recovers well after long efforts
Smooth turnover at all paces with adequate energy return; one tester wished the base layer were slightly softer for improved rollover
Surprisingly stable for its extreme stack height (45mm/39mm); dual-density foam and substantial outsole resist lateral motion, though narrow-footed runners may experience hot spots
Copious outsole rubber coverage across segmented design provides excellent grip in varied conditions including icy surfaces; long-term durability expected to be very good
Best for long runs, marathon training, and mid-pack racers; designed as a daily trainer with LightSpray upper — not a pure race shoe
